simple.meaning: to be untrue , in word (to lie , feign , disown ) or deed (to disappoint , fail , cringe )
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to כָּחַשׁ (H3584) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 22 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: כָּחַשׁ (kâchash) means to be untrue , in word (to lie , feign , disown ) or deed (to disappoint , fail , cringe ) First listed occurrence: 1Kgs 13 18.

definitions.short: to be untrue , in word (to lie , feign , disown ) or deed (to disappoint , fail , cringe )
definitions.usage: deceive, deny, dissemble, fail, deal falsely, be found liars, (be-) lie, lying, submit selves.
definitions.full: H3584. kachash כָּחַשׁ verb be disappointing, deceive, fail, grow lean (Late Hebrew כָּחַשׁ grow lean ; Hiph`il convict of falsehood, refute ; Aramaic כְּחַשׁ grow lean ; כַּחְשָׁא leanness , כְּחִישׁוּתָא leanness, weakness ; Aph`el as Late Hebrew Hiph`il) — Qal. Perfect 3masculine singular מִשָּׁ֑מֶן כָּחַשׁ וּבְשָׂרִי Psa 109:24 my flesh hath grown lean (away) from fatness (|| מִצּוֺם כָּֽשְׁלוּ בִּרְכַּי ). Niph`al Imperfect לָךְ אֹיְבֶיךָ וְיִכָּֽחֲשׂוּ Deut 33:29 thine enemies shall cringe (come cringing, i.e. originally act deceptively, feigning obedience ) to thee (compare also Pi`el 3, Hithpa`el ) Pi`el Perfect 3masculine singular כִּחֵשׁ 1Kin 13:18 ; Hab 3:17 ; וְכִּ֫חֶשׁ consecutive (before monosyll.) Leviticus 5:22; Job 8:18 , etc.; Imperfect (בָּהּׅ יְכַ֫חֶשּׁ Hosea 9:2-3 ;feminine singular וַתְּכַחֵשׂ Gen 18:15 , etc.; Infinitive absolute כַּחֵשׁ Hosea 4:2 ; Isa 59:13 ; construct Zech 13:4 ; — 1 device , absolute Gen 18:15 (J), Josh 7:11 (JE), Hosea 4:2 ( וכחשׁ אלה together = false swearing according to We Kl. Pr .; + וְנָאֹ֑ף וְגָנֹב וְרָצֹחַ ), compare בַּעֲמִיתוֺ אִישׁ תְשַׁקְּרוּ וְלֹא תְכַחֲשׁוּ וְלֹאֿ תִגְנֹ֑בוּ לֹא Lev 19:11 (H); כ ׳לְמַעַן Zech 13:4 in order to deceive ; followed by לְ person 1Kin 13:18 ; Job 31:28 ; followed by בְ person and of thing Leviticus 5:21, בְ of thing Lev 6:22 . 2 act deceptively against (i.e. seem to acknowledge, but not really do so), followed by בְ person Josh 24:27 (E), Jer 5:12 ; Isa 59:13 ; Job 8:18 , apparently also יכ ׳וְתִירוֺשׁ בָּהּ Hosea 9:2 and new wine shall deny her (Israel; i.e. refuse to acknowledge her as its mistress, not yield itself to her); absolute Prov 30:9 . 3 cringe = come cringing (make shew of obedience, see Niph`al) followed by בְ person Psa 18:45 (Hithpa`el in || 2Sam 22:45 ); followed by לְ person Psa 66:3 ; 81:16 . 4 disappoint, fail , absolute זַיִת מַעֲשֵׂה כִּחֵשׁ Hab 3:17 the product of the olive hath failed (in sense compare Hosea 9:2 above) Hithpa`el Imperfect לִי יִתְכַּחֲשׁוּ 2Sam 22:45 shall come cringing to me (|| Psa 18:45 . see above)
